tem <- env[,38:43]

library(vegan)

# Calculate distance matrices for phy and tem dataframes
phy_dist <- vegdist(phy, method = "bray") # or another distance method, e.g., "bray"
tem_dist <- vegdist(tem, method = "bray") # or another distance method, e.g., "bray"
tech_dist <- vegdist(tech, method = "bray")

# Perform Mantel test
mantel_result_phy_tem <- mantel(phy_dist, tem_dist, method = "pearson", permutations = 999)

mantel_result_phy_tech <- mantel(phy_dist, tech_dist, method = "pearson", permutations = 999)
mantel_result_phy_tech

mantel_result_tech_tem <- mantel(tech_dist, tem_dist, method = "pearson", permutations = 999)
mantel_result_tech_tem

## dbRDA 
library(vegan)
library(adespatial)

#metabolite
species <-  read.delim(file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "metabolite_ymy", "si_metabo.txt"),
                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE, row.names = 1,header = T,
                       sep = "\t")

env <- read.delim(file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "metabolite_ymy", "full_pred_si_glm_update.txt"),
                  stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE, row.names = 1,header = T,
                  sep = "\t")
species <- species[,-c(1:3)]
env <- env[,-c(1:3)]

tech <- data.frame(env[,48])
Env <- data.frame(env[,c(1:37)])
time <- data.frame(env[,38:47])

species_hel <- decostand(species, method = 'hellinger')

rda.data = species_hel

#rda forward selections of every group, using AEM variables (through RDA axes)
mod0 = rda(rda.data ~ 1, tech) #model with intercept only
mod1 = rda(rda.data ~., tech) #model with all variables
step.res.tech = ordiR2step(mod0, mod1, perm.max =1000) #about 2.3% explained

mod0 = rda(rda.data ~ 1, Env) #model with intercept only
mod1 = rda(rda.data ~., Env) #model with all variables
step.res.Env = ordiR2step(mod0, mod1, perm.max =1000) #about 10.3% explained
step.forward.Env = forward.sel(rda.data, Env)

mod0 = rda(rda.data ~ 1, time) #model with intercept only
mod1 = rda(rda.data ~., time) #model with all variables
step.res.time = ordiR2step(mod0, mod1, perm.max =1000) #about 7.13% explained
step.forward.time = forward.sel(rda.data, time)

mod0 = rda(rda.data ~ 1, time) #model with intercept only
mod1 = rda(rda.data ~., time) #model with all variables
step.res.time = ordiR2step(mod0, mod1, perm.max =1000) #about 10.49% explained
time.R2a = RsquareAdj(mod1)$adj.r.squared
step.forward.time = forward.sel(rda.data, time, adjR2thresh = time.R2a)

#vegan variable selection procedure for every group, for dbRDA (used in paper)
#using AEM variables
mod0.db = capscale(rda.data ~ 1, dist="bray", data=tech, add=TRUE)
mod1.db = capscale(rda.data ~., dist="bray", data=tech, add=TRUE)
step.res.db.tech = ordiR2step(mod0.db, mod1.db, perm.max = 1000) #about % explained      

# tech.select.db = tech[, attributes(step.res.db.tech$terms)$term.labels]

colnames(tech) = "batch"
tech.select.db = tech

mod0.db = capscale(rda.data ~ 1, dist="bray", data=Env, add=TRUE)
mod1.db = capscale(rda.data ~., dist="bray", data=Env, add=TRUE)
step.res.db.Env = ordiR2step(mod0.db, mod1.db, perm.max = 1000) #about % explained   
Env.select.db = Env[, attributes(step.res.db.Env$terms)$term.labels]
Env.select.db


mod0.db = capscale(rda.data ~ 1, dist="bray", data=time, add=TRUE)
mod1.db = capscale(rda.data ~., dist="bray", data=time, add=TRUE)
step.res.db.time = ordiR2step(mod0.db, mod1.db, perm.max = 1000) #about % explained   
time.select.db = time[, attributes(step.res.db.time$terms)$term.labels]
time.select.db
#combining all for variable selection
allfactors = cbind(tech, Env, time) 

mod0.db = capscale(rda.data ~ 1, dist = "bray", data = allfactors) #using add = TRUE option will give different results, more variables
mod1.db = capscale(rda.data ~., dist = "bray", data = allfactors)
step.res.db.all = ordiR2step(mod0.db, mod1.db, perm.max = 1000, pin = 0.05) #about % explained  
all.select.db = allfactors[, attributes(step.res.db.all$terms)$term.labels]
all.select.db


#calculating distance between samples 
rda.data.dist = vegdist(rda.data,method = "bray",na.rm = TRUE, diag = FALSE)
#dbRDA varpart, assuming four groups
dbRDA.MEM.varpart = varpart(rda.data.dist, tech.select.db, Env.select.db, time.select.db)
dbRDA.MEM.varpart = varpart(rda.data.dist, tech.select.db, time.select.db)
# not adding AEM for now

#lumping location and behavior together, so three groups + temporal group

#the techinical is 2.6%, the enviromental, locabehav, and the temporal all account for 10% each.
par(mfrow = c(1,2))
showvarparts(4)
plot(dbRDA.MEM.varpart)

dbRDA.MEM.varpart #show R.square data

 #crude varpart without forward selection of each group

dbRDA.MEM.crude.varpart1
par(mfrow = c(1,1))
showvarparts(4)
plot(dbRDA.MEM.crude.varpart)

  #takes output from rcorr function, adjusting p value matrix accroding to fdr principles
  matrixPadjust = function(res, select = c(1:nrow(res$P))){
    print(select)
    temp.p = c(res$P)
    temp.p[is.na(temp.p)] = 0
    temp.p.adj = p.adjust(temp.p, method = "fdr")
    p.adj.matrix = matrix(temp.p.adj, nrow = ncol(res$P), ncol=ncol(res$P), dimnames = list(rownames = colnames(res$P), colnames = colnames(res$P)))
    return(p.adj.matrix)
  }
  adjusted.res2.p = matrixPadjust(res2)
  #pls package also has a function called corrplot
  corrplot::corrplot(res2$r, order = "hclust", p.mat = adjusted.res2.p, sig.level = 0.01,
                     insig = "blank", diag = FALSE, tl.cex=1, addrect = 12, method="color", 
                     outline=TRUE, col=brewer.pal(n=10, name="PuOr"), tl.srt=45, tl.col="black")

                        stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE,
                        header = T, sep = "\t") 
    
    
    
    #using calc.relimp from the relaimpo package, no limitation on the number of testing variables imposed
    
    cicalc = function(delta, ref){ #90% confidence interval
      delta = sort(delta)
      range = quantile(delta, c(0.05, 0.95))
      ratio.ci = as.numeric(ref) - as.numeric(c(range[2], range[1]))
      names(ratio.ci) = c("5%", "95%")
      names(ref) = "reference"
      return(c(ref, ratio.ci))
    }
    
    ecdf_fun = function(x,perc) {ecdf(x)(perc)} #retrun percentile given value in a distribution
    
    
    #This part takes a lot of time, about 20 hours, result is saved as a rds object
    relaimp.df = data.frame(matrix(nrow=3))
    relaimp.rsq = c()
    relaimp.adjrsq = c()
    relaimp.p = c()
    relaimp.var.y = c()
    ratio.master = list()
    
    #si
    for (name in as.character(input$X[input$padjust<0.05])){ #only on genera that occured in more than 100 samples
      #name="Stereum"
      print(name)
      lm.fit = lm(rda.data[,name]~., data=all.select.db)
      lm.rela = calc.relimp(lm.fit, type = c("lmg"), rela = TRUE, groups = list(spa=c(8,9,13)+1,env= c(1,2,3,4,5,6,10,11,12)+1,tech=c(7)+1)) #this function actually has a groups option to combine variables into groups
      #group 1 is env, group 2 is spa, group 3 is tech
      reference.temp = lm.rela@lmg
      #relaimp.df = cbind(relaimp.df, lm.rela@lmg)
      relaimp.var.y = c(relaimp.var.y, lm.rela@var.y)
      lm.summary = summary(lm.fit)
      relaimp.rsq = c(relaimp.rsq, lm.summary$r.squared)
      relaimp.adjrsq = c(relaimp.adjrsq, lm.summary$adj.r.squared)
      refratio = reference.temp[1]/reference.temp[2]
      refenv = reference.temp[1]
      refloc = reference.temp[2]
      reftech = reference.temp[3]
      
      data.slice = rda.data[,name]
      set.seed = 123
      bootstrapping.matrix = replicate(200, sample(1:114, 114, replace = TRUE)) #each COLUMN is a sampling
      relaimp.df.temp = data.frame(matrix(nrow=3))
      #relaimp.var.y.temp = c()
      for (i in 1:ncol(bootstrapping.matrix)){
        #print(i)
        rda.data.temp = data.slice[bootstrapping.matrix[,i]]
        all.select.db.temp = all.select.db[bootstrapping.matrix[,i],]
        lm.fit.temp = lm(rda.data.temp~., data=all.select.db.temp)
        lm.rela.temp = calc.relimp(lm.fit.temp, type = c("lmg"), rela = TRUE, groups = list(spa=c(8,9,13)+1,env= c(1,2,3,4,5,6,10,11,12)+1,tech=c(7)+1))  #this function actually has a groups option to combine variables into groups
        relaimp.df.temp = cbind(relaimp.df.temp, lm.rela.temp@lmg)
        #relaimp.var.y.temp = c(relaimp.var.y.temp, lm.rela.temp@var.y)
      }
      relaimp.df.temp = relaimp.df.temp[,-1]
      resample.ratio = unlist(relaimp.df.temp[1,]/relaimp.df.temp[2,])
      resample.env = unlist(relaimp.df.temp[1,])
      resample.loc = unlist(relaimp.df.temp[2,])
      resample.tech = unlist(relaimp.df.temp[3,])
      
      deltaratio = refratio - resample.ratio
      deltaenv =refenv - resample.env
      deltaloc = refloc - resample.loc
      deltatech = reftech - resample.tech
      
      #range = quantile(deltaratio.sort, c(0.05, 0.95))
      #ratio.ci = as.numeric(refratio) - as.numeric(c(range[2], range[1]))
      #names(ratio.ci) = c("5%", "95%")
      #names(refratio) = "reference"
      #ratio.ci
      ratio.master[[name]] = data.frame(ratio = cicalc(deltaratio, refratio),
                                        env = cicalc(deltaenv, refenv),
                                        loc = cicalc(deltaloc, refloc),
                                        tech = cicalc(deltatech, reftech),
                                        onequantile = ecdf_fun(resample.ratio,1) #quantile of probability of env/loc <= 1
      )
    }
    
    
    #di

      #group 1 is env, group 2 is spa, group 3 is tech
      reference.temp = lm.rela@lmg

      relaimp.df.temp = data.frame(matrix(nrow=3))

      for (i in 1:ncol(bootstrapping.matrix)){
        #print(i)

        all.select.db.temp = all.select.db[bootstrapping.matrix[,i],]
        lm.fit.temp = lm(rda.data.temp~., data=all.select.db.temp)
        lm.rela.temp = calc.relimp(lm.fit.temp, type = c("lmg"), rela = TRUE, groups = list(env= c(5,6)+1, spa=c(1,2,3,4)+1, tech=c(7)+1))  #this function actually has a groups option to combine variables into groups
        relaimp.df.temp = cbind(relaimp.df.temp, lm.rela.temp@lmg)
        #relaimp.var.y.temp = c(relaimp.var.y.temp, lm.rela.temp@var.y)
      }
      relaimp.df.temp = relaimp.df.temp[,-1]
      resample.ratio = unlist(relaimp.df.temp[1,]/relaimp.df.temp[2,])
      resample.env = unlist(relaimp.df.temp[1,])
      resample.loc = unlist(relaimp.df.temp[2,])
      resample.tech = unlist(relaimp.df.temp[3,])
      
      deltaratio = refratio - resample.ratio
      deltaenv =refenv - resample.env
      deltaloc = refloc - resample.loc
      deltatech = reftech - resample.tech
      
      #range = quantile(deltaratio.sort, c(0.05, 0.95))
      #ratio.ci = as.numeric(refratio) - as.numeric(c(range[2], range[1]))
      #names(ratio.ci) = c("5%", "95%")
      #names(refratio) = "reference"
      #ratio.ci
      ratio.master[[name]] = data.frame(ratio = cicalc(deltaratio, refratio),
                                        env = cicalc(deltaenv, refenv),
                                        loc = cicalc(deltaloc, refloc),
                                        tech = cicalc(deltatech, reftech),
                                        onequantile = ecdf_fun(resample.ratio,1) #quantile of probability of env/loc <= 1
      )
    }

## fast gbrm


suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(gbm)
  library(caret)
  library(dplyr)
})

run_gbm_oof_with_importance <- function(df, target_col="type", K=10,
                                        ntrees=2000, depth=7, shrink=0.01,
                                        bag_frac=0.6, min_node=10,
                                        top_n=30, seed=1) {
  
  set.seed(seed)
  
  # numeric only + target
  num_cols <- sapply(df, is.numeric)
  num_cols[target_col] <- TRUE
  df <- df[, num_cols, drop=FALSE]
  df <- df[complete.cases(df), , drop=FALSE]
  
  folds <- createFolds(df[[target_col]], k = K, list = TRUE, returnTrain = FALSE)
  
  pred_oof <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(df))
  imp_list <- vector("list", K)
  
  for (k in seq_along(folds)) {
    test_idx  <- folds[[k]]
    train_idx <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(df)), test_idx)
    
    train_df <- df[train_idx, , drop=FALSE]
    test_df  <- df[test_idx,  , drop=FALSE]
    
    m <- gbm(
      formula = as.formula(paste(target_col, "~ .")),
      data = train_df,
      distribution = "gaussian",
      n.trees = ntrees,
      cv.folds = 0,
      shrinkage = shrink,
      interaction.depth = depth,
      bag.fraction = bag_frac,
      n.minobsinnode = min_node,
      verbose = FALSE
    )
    
    pred_oof[test_idx] <- predict(m, newdata = test_df, n.trees = ntrees, type = "response")
    
    imp <- summary(m, n.trees = ntrees, plotit = FALSE)  # contains var + rel.inf
    imp$fold <- k
    imp_list[[k]] <- imp[1:min(top_n, nrow(imp)), c("var", "rel.inf", "fold")]
    
    cat("Fold", k, "done\n")
  }
  
  y <- df[[target_col]]
  resid <- y - pred_oof
  RMSE <- sqrt(mean(resid^2))
  R2   <- 1 - sum(resid^2) / sum((y - mean(y))^2)
  cor_pear <- cor.test(pred_oof, y, method="pearson")
  
  imp_df <- bind_rows(imp_list)
  imp_sum <- imp_df %>%
    group_by(var) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_rel_inf = mean(rel.inf),
      freq = n(),                 # 出现在top_n的fold次数，<=K
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_rel_inf))
  
  list(
    pred = data.frame(y=y, pred=pred_oof),
    RMSE = RMSE,
    R2 = R2,
    cor = cor_pear,
    importance_raw = imp_df,
    importance_summary = imp_sum
  )
}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({

# 核心函数：给定数据+特征集合，做10-fold OOF + 输出fold明细 
run_gbm_oof <- function(df, target_col,
                        feature_cols = NULL,
                        K = 10,
                        ntrees = 2000, depth = 3, shrink = 0.01,
                        bag_frac = 0.6, min_node = 10,
                        top_n = 30, seed = 1) {
  
  set.seed(seed)
  
  stopifnot(target_col %in% colnames(df))
  
  # 只用数值列（gbm需要数值/有序因子，这里直接强制数值以免出坑）
  num_cols <- sapply(df, is.numeric)
  num_cols[target_col] <- TRUE
  df2 <- df[, num_cols, drop = FALSE]
  df2 <- df2[complete.cases(df2), , drop = FALSE]
  
  # feature_cols 为空：用所有除target外的列
  if (is.null(feature_cols)) {
    feature_cols <- setdiff(colnames(df2), target_col)
  } else {
    feature_cols <- intersect(feature_cols, colnames(df2))
  }
  
  # 组装建模数据
  model_df <- df2[, c(target_col, feature_cols), drop = FALSE]
  stopifnot(!(target_col %in% feature_cols))
  
  folds <- createFolds(model_df[[target_col]], k = K, list = TRUE, returnTrain = FALSE)
  
  pred_oof <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(model_df))
  
  # 保存每个fold的预测明细（你要的 test_y / pred_y）
  fold_pred_list <- vector("list", K)
  
  # 保存每个fold的topN importance（用于第一阶段挑top30）
  imp_list <- vector("list", K)
  
  for (k in seq_along(folds)) {
    test_idx  <- folds[[k]]
    train_idx <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(model_df)), test_idx)
    
    train_df <- model_df[train_idx, , drop = FALSE]
    test_df  <- model_df[test_idx,  , drop = FALSE]
    
    m <- gbm(
      formula = as.formula(paste(target_col, "~ .")),
      data = train_df,
      distribution = "gaussian",
      n.trees = ntrees,
      cv.folds = 0,
      shrinkage = shrink,
      interaction.depth = depth,
      bag.fraction = bag_frac,
      n.minobsinnode = min_node,
      verbose = FALSE
    )
    
    pred <- predict(m, newdata = test_df, n.trees = ntrees, type = "response")
    pred_oof[test_idx] <- pred
    
    fold_pred_list[[k]] <- data.frame(
      fold = k,
      row_id = test_idx,                 # 在model_df内的行号（可用于回填/对齐）
      y = test_df[[target_col]],
      pred = pred
    )
    
    imp <- summary(m, n.trees = ntrees, plotit = FALSE)
    imp$fold <- k
    imp_list[[k]] <- imp[1:min(top_n, nrow(imp)), c("var", "rel.inf", "fold")]
    
    cat("Fold", k, "done\n")
  }
  
  # OOF性能
  y <- model_df[[target_col]]
  resid <- y - pred_oof
  RMSE <- sqrt(mean(resid^2))
  R2   <- 1 - sum(resid^2) / sum((y - mean(y))^2)
  cor_pear <- cor.test(pred_oof, y, method="pearson")
  
  # 汇总importance（第一阶段会用到）
  imp_df <- bind_rows(imp_list)
  imp_sum <- imp_df %>%
    group_by(var) %>%
    summarise(mean_rel_inf = mean(rel.inf),
              freq = n(),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_rel_inf))
  
  # 组装OOF逐样本结果（带fold）
  fold_pred <- bind_rows(fold_pred_list) %>%
    arrange(row_id)
  
  oof_pred <- data.frame(
    y = y,
    pred = pred_oof
  )
  
  list(
    model_df = model_df,                 # 想看最终进模型的数据
    feature_cols = feature_cols,
    pred_oof = oof_pred,                 # 全样本OOF预测（无fold）
    fold_pred = fold_pred,               # 每fold的test_y/pred_y明细（有fold）
    RMSE = RMSE,
    R2 = R2,
    cor = cor_pear,
    importance_raw = imp_df,
    importance_summary = imp_sum
  )
}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(gbm)
  library(caret)
  library(dplyr)
})

nested_top30_gbm <- function(df, target_col="C",
                             K_outer=10, K_inner=5,
                             ntrees=3000, depth=3, shrink=0.01,
                             bag_frac=0.6, min_node=10,
                             top_n=30, seed=1) {
  
  set.seed(seed)
  
  # numeric only + target
  num_cols <- sapply(df, is.numeric)
  num_cols[target_col] <- TRUE
  df <- df[, num_cols, drop=FALSE]
  df <- df[complete.cases(df), , drop=FALSE]
  
  outer_folds <- createFolds(df[[target_col]], k=K_outer, list=TRUE)
  
  pred_oof <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(df))
  selected_list <- vector("list", K_outer)
  
  for (fo in seq_along(outer_folds)) {
    test_idx  <- outer_folds[[fo]]
    train_idx <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(df)), test_idx)
    
    train_df <- df[train_idx, , drop=FALSE]
    test_df  <- df[test_idx,  , drop=FALSE]
    
    #inner CV: select top30 only using TRAIN data
    inner_folds <- createFolds(train_df[[target_col]], k=K_inner, list=TRUE)
    imp_inner_list <- vector("list", K_inner)
    
    for (fi in seq_along(inner_folds)) {
      in_test  <- inner_folds[[fi]]
      in_train <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(train_df)), in_test)
      
      tr_in <- train_df[in_train, , drop=FALSE]
      
      m_in <- gbm(
        as.formula(paste(target_col, "~ .")),
        data = tr_in,
        distribution="gaussian",
        n.trees=ntrees,
        cv.folds=0,
        shrinkage=shrink,
        interaction.depth=depth,
        bag.fraction=bag_frac,
        n.minobsinnode=min_node,
        verbose=FALSE
      )
      
      imp_in <- summary(m_in, n.trees=ntrees, plotit=FALSE)
      imp_inner_list[[fi]] <- imp_in[1:min(top_n, nrow(imp_in)), c("var","rel.inf")]
    }
    
    imp_inner <- bind_rows(imp_inner_list) %>%
      group_by(var) %>%
      summarise(mean_rel_inf = mean(rel.inf), freq = n(), .groups="drop") %>%
      arrange(desc(mean_rel_inf))
    
    top30_vars <- imp_inner %>% slice(1:top_n) %>% pull(var)
    selected_list[[fo]] <- data.frame(outer_fold=fo, var=top30_vars)
    
    # train final model on full outer-train using ONLY top30
    train30 <- train_df[, c(target_col, top30_vars), drop=FALSE]
    test30  <- test_df[,  c(target_col, top30_vars), drop=FALSE]
    
    m_out <- gbm(
      as.formula(paste(target_col, "~ .")),
      data = train30,
      distribution="gaussian",
      n.trees=ntrees,
      cv.folds=0,
      shrinkage=shrink,
      interaction.depth=depth,
      bag.fraction=bag_frac,
      n.minobsinnode=min_node,
      verbose=FALSE
    )
    
    pred_oof[test_idx] <- predict(m_out, newdata=test30, n.trees=ntrees, type="response")
    
    cat("Outer fold", fo, "done\n")
  }
  
  y <- df[[target_col]]
  resid <- y - pred_oof
  RMSE <- sqrt(mean(resid^2))
  R2   <- 1 - sum(resid^2) / sum((y - mean(y))^2)
  cor_pear <- cor.test(pred_oof, y, method="pearson")
  
  selected_df <- bind_rows(selected_list)
  
  list(
    pred = data.frame(y=y, pred=pred_oof),
    RMSE = RMSE,
    R2 = R2,
    cor = cor_pear,
    selected_top30_each_outer_fold = selected_df
  )
}

# 通用指标计算函数
calc_metrics <- function(d, x, y) {
  x <- d[[x]]; y <- d[[y]]
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
  x <- x[ok]; y <- y[ok]
  
  resid <- y - x
  rmse <- sqrt(mean(resid^2))
  r2   <- 1 - sum((y - x)^2) / sum((y - mean(y))^2)  # 注意：这里等价于用pred解释actual
  ct   <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(x, y, method="pearson"))
  
  list(
    rmse = rmse,
    r2 = r2,
    rho = unname(ct$estimate),
    p = ct$p.value
  )
}

fmt_p <- function(p) {
  ifelse(p < 2.2e-16, "<2.2e-16",
         ifelse(p < 1e-3, sprintf("%.1e", p), sprintf("%.3f", p)))
}

# 生成一个 Pred vs Actual 面板：点 + y=x + 拟合线 + 指标块 
pred_actual_panel <- function(d, xcol, ycol, xlab, ylab, tag=NULL) {
  
  m <- calc_metrics(d, xcol, ycol)
  
  # 指标文本（放右上角）
  lab <- paste0(
    "R² = ", sprintf("%.3f", m$r2), "\n",
    "RMSE = ", sprintf("%.3f", m$rmse), "\n",
    "\u03C1 = ", sprintf("%.3f", m$rho), "\n",
    "p = ", fmt_p(m$p)
  )
  
  # 计算坐标位置：右上角留白一点
  xr <- range(d[[xcol]], na.rm=TRUE)
  yr <- range(d[[ycol]], na.rm=TRUE)
  x_pos <- xr[1] + 0.98 * diff(xr)
  y_pos <- yr[1] + 0.98 * diff(yr)
  
  ggplot(d, aes(x = .data[[xcol]], y = .data[[ycol]])) +
    # 点：两组
    geom_point(aes(shape = group, color = group),
               size = 2.2, alpha = 0.75, stroke = 0.6) +
    
    # 理想线：y = x
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1,
                linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8, color = "grey55") +
    
    # 拟合线：线性回归（校准）
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE,
                linewidth = 1.1, color = "black") +
    scale_color_manual(values = myPalette) +
    
 #   指标块
    # annotate("label",
    #          x = x_pos, y = y_pos,
    #          label = lab, hjust = 1, vjust = 1,
    #          label.size = 0.2, size = 3.2,
    #          fill = "white", alpha = 0.85) +

    labs(x = xlab, y = ylab, tag = tag) +
    
    # 更省版面的主题
    theme_classic(base_size = 20) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.margin = margin(b = -6),
      plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 20),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 20)
    ) +
    guides(
      color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 3)),
      shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 3))
    )
}

assign_guild <- function(x, map) {
  for (nm in names(map)) {
    if (x %in% map[[nm]]) return(nm)
  }
  return("Unclassified")
}

ks_guild_df <- tibble(var = ks_top20) %>%
  mutate(
    guild = vapply(var, assign_guild, character(1), map = guild_map),
    guild = factor(

      levels = c(
        "Arid/biocrust Actinobacteria",
        "N cycling (nitrifiers)",
        "Proteobacteria (rhizosphere/fast-growing)",
        "Oligotroph/soil core (Acidobacteria)",
        "Fungal decomposers",
        "Other slow-growing soil bacteria",
        "Unclassified"
      )
    )

 # Convert y to numeric (if necessary)
 age <- as.numeric(otu.select$type)
 
 # Create a list of response variables
 response_vars <- colnames(otu.select)[1:30]
 
 # Create an empty data frame to store the results
 results <- data.frame(response_var = numeric(),
                       slope_coeff = numeric(),
                       p_value = numeric(),
                       adj_r_square = numeric(),
                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
 
 #family = quasipoisson(link = "log")
 # Loop over the response variables and fit a GLM for each
 for (i in seq_along(response_vars)) {
   # Fit the GLM with Poisson error distribution and log link function
   model <- glm(otu.select[, response_vars[i]] ~ age, data = otu.select)
   # Check assumptions and extract slope coefficient and p-value for whole model
   
   #model <- glm(data[, response_vars[i]] ~ age, data = data)
   # norm_test <- shapiro.test(resid(model)) #to perform the Shapiro-Wilk normality test on a vector or a data frame column
   # print(norm_test)
   p_val <- summary(model)$coefficients[2,4]
   print(p_val)
   slope_coeff <- summary(model)$coefficients[2, 1]
   adj_r_square <- with(summary(model), 1 - deviance/null.deviance)
   
   # Adjust p-value using BH method
   #adj_p_val <- p.adjust(p_val, method = "BH")
   
   # Store the results in the data frame
   results[i, ] <- list(response_var = response_vars[i],
                        slope_coeff = slope_coeff,
                        p_value = p_val,
                        adj_r_square = adj_r_square)
 }

 table(final_result$padjust < 0.05)
